title: Two brought-forward STCLs (FY 2019-20 Rs 40,000, FY 2022-23 Rs 50,000) against STCG of Rs 60,000: oldest used first
rules: Income-tax Act 1961 s.74 (Income-tax Act 2025 s.111 [secondary mapping, not verified]): the net capital-gains loss of a year is carried forward to the following assessment year; (1)(a) a short-term loss 'shall be set off' against any capital gain of that year; (1)(b) a long-term loss only against long-term capital gain; (1)(c) the balance is carried on; (2) not for more than eight assessment years immediately succeeding the assessment year for which it was first computed

Income-tax Act 1961 s.80 (Income-tax Act 2025 s.121 [secondary mapping, not verified]) with s.139(3) and s.139(1): a capital loss is carried forward and set off under s.74 only if it was determined in a return filed within the time allowed by s.139(1)
Income-tax Act 1961 s.111A(1) as amended by Finance (No.2) Act 2024: STCG on STT-paid equity 20 % for transfers on/after 23-Jul-2024
Health and Education Cess 4 % (Finance Act 2025 s.2)
derivation: Manual entries, both returns on time: STCL 40,000.00 of origin fy 2020 (last_fy 2028) and STCL 50,000.00 of origin fy 2023 (last_fy 2031).
fy 2026: the losses total 90,000 but only 60,000 of gain exists -> bf_set_off_short 60,000.00; net STCG 0; tax 0.00, cess 0.00, total 0.00.

Order (s.74 does not fix it; interpretive): oldest origin first, as the older loss expires first and Schedule CFL lists years in that order -> fy 2020 loss 40,000 used in full, fy 2023 loss 20,000 used, 30,000 left.
Ledger: 2020 short amount 40,000.00 remaining 0.00 last_fy 2028 used; 2023 short amount 50,000.00 remaining 30,000.00 last_fy 2031 available.
Alternative (newest first): 2023 remaining 0.00 used; 2020 remaining 30,000.00 available (last_fy 2028). Tax identical.
